verdict.rationale: A probe found a public OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json, which is strong evidence of a documented, machine-readable public API. This is backed by observability-as-code docs for defining dashboards and data sources in code via CI/CD and the terminal, plus an official MCP server that lets agents drive Grafana programmatically. missing for 10: first-party API reference excerpts describing endpoint coverage and authentication (e.g. service-account tokens), confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers the Grafana instance HTTP API rather than only grafana.com, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
